newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bank of Japan says offers to buy bills and T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Japan says offers to buy bills and T-bills.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) said on Friday that it offered to buy 300 billion yen worth of commercial bills through an auction in an agreement starting on November 5 and ending on December 2.
The central bank also said it offered to buy 200 billion yen in Treasury bills through repurchase agreements starting on November 6 and ending on November 25. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-3-3432-8676
